summary: Temporary elevated GPU‑lab access + analytics service account for cross‑team research contractor onboarding
description:
Issue summary: We are onboarding a 3-month research contractor who will work across Research and Platform teams. Request is for: (1) a time‑bounded elevated service account (sa-research-temp) with access to the analytics BigQuery dataset and read/write access to the instrumentation S3 bucket, and (2) temporary GPU‑lab sudo (limited to journald/driver restart and nvidia-smi) on two GPU nodes for model prototyping.

Impact: Contractor needs access on day 1 of their contract (2026-03-16) to avoid blocking experiments. We need a secure, auditable temporary access path and clear expiry/receipt process to satisfy Security and HR requirements.

Background: Hiring manager (Elena Park) flagged that the contractor will be running short experiments that touch both infra metrics and model training prototypes. Security prefers service account creation rather than user-based lateral permissions. Existing offboarding automation can revoke SCIM-based user access, but we need guidance for timeboxed service accounts and lab sudo policies.

Request details: 
- Create service account sa-research-temp with: BigQuery: dataset analytics_research_rw, S3: s3://instrumentation/prod/research/* (read/write).
- Create IAM group research-temp-3mo used only for the contractor and set expiry to 2026-06-16.
- Grant sudo-lite on gpu-node-03 and gpu-node-07 restricted to: systemctl restart nvidia-driver.service, tail/journalctl for /var/log/nvidia*, and nvidia-smi. No package installs or useradd allowed.
- Ensure KMS keys used by the SA are logged and covered by audit policies.
- Provide a handoff checklist to HR to confirm contractor offboarding and service account rotation on expiry.

Steps already taken: 
- Hiring manager created a WFH access request form and attached signed NDAs (linked in comments).
- SCIM provisioning for the contractor account was tested in staging; full sync delay to prod is estimated 24 hours.
- SRE pre-checked GPU node images for required driver versions.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Service account created, credentials escrowed in Vault with 3‑month TTL and rotation scheduled on 2026-06-16.
- GPU sudo-lite role implemented and tested by SRE with one dry run command executed and logged.
- Owner (Elena Park) and Security contact (Priya Nair) sign off in comments.

Policy question to resolve: What is the maximum allowed TTL for ephemeral service accounts for contractors per current access policy? Security previously mentioned 90 days as a guideline; request confirmation if exceptions are allowed and what additional controls (MFA, periodic attestations) are required.

Notes: Please do not grant blanket network or console admin rights. All actions must be logged to the central audit topic and Slack channel #onboarding-audit.
